notes: Evidence: r2026-10-10/01-dc-arena/dc/<id>.md with images in dc/img/. Only the posts the round cites are summarised; every fetched post is in the folder.
The 10-08 update went live at 16:00 KST. Posts before it describe the Macaron meta; posts after it the Chardonnay meta. Each summary says which.
Mode tags as in the 10-07 round: visible names, trophy counts near 1,300-2,500 after the 10-08 reset and '명성' rewards are regular Arena; S0xxx tags, 와레나 and +175 medals are Rumble.
Sprites: Rye wears a cowboy hat; Nameless Cake Hound is the small red-and-white creature; Cherry Cola is the dark-red-haired girl. Read against the roster cards on dc:83283's formation screen.

posts.title_en: Use the evasion deck: it takes a server #90 to Arena top 10

Gear in the replies: Skill AMP + crit rate x3, focus + haste x2, Skill AMP + haste x1, evasion + DR x3, evasion + haste x3; next season evasion + crit RES x3. Expects Chardonnay's one-shot meta to hurt flimsy evasion decks.

posts.title_en: Shouldn't the revenge system be fixed?
posts.summary_en: Season 5's last day. The leader can't revenge a rival they hit first, pays gems to find them, and never sees the rival's attack deck, while the rival revenges for free and gains 10-20 points per win against 5-6 lost. Replies ask for a one-day revenge limit or visible attack decks.
mechanics: Revenge attacks cost no gems and leave no defense record; the defender never sees the attacking deck.

quotes.kr: 내가 먼저 치면 나는 다시는 얘를 복수로 칠수가없음

posts.title_en: Arena decks after the new cookie: a history and a forecast
posts.summary_en: A history of the Arena meta (ranged haste meta, Seeker/Pinot, Bari/Moon Rabbit) and a forecast: Chardonnay's Skill-AMP-scaled crit makes crit RES pointless, evasion decks become mainstream, defense stats DR + evasion, attack stats Skill AMP + crit DMG + haste. Replies: an accuracy set always beats evasion; 송송다리 thinks crit RES matters more.

posts.title_en: An analysis of crit RES vs DR
posts.summary_en: A recommended post with graphs: enemy crit DMG barely changes the trade-off; enemy crit rate does. High enemy crit favours DR, low favours crit RES; keep crit rate / crit RES in step with DR. Pick what you can roll higher.
mechanics: Against high enemy crit, DR is worth more than crit RES; against low crit, crit RES.

quotes.kr: 치확이 높을수록 피감을 더 챙기는게 유리

posts.title_en: Is it true perks don't apply to Arena defense?
posts.summary_en: One reply: they apply, but some skills aim by arena position, so attacks are favoured. dc:85226 and dc:84397: the rumour that defenses get no perks persists.
disagreements: Perks on defense: apply (with an arena-side skill quirk) vs don't apply.

quotes.kr: 적용되는데 스킬 중에 어떤건 쿠키 위치가 아니라 아레나 위치 기준으로 적용돼서 공격 측이 유리하다고 하던데
quotes.en: They apply, but some skills go by arena position, not cookie position, so the attacker is favoured, they say

posts.title_en: How do I beat a 10★ Bari deck in Arena?
posts.summary_en: The Rye all-in deck beat the rival's 9★ Bari sometimes; at 10★ it loses in a second. Replies: it's not a counter, just a deck that can contend; evasion with prayer; Angel with Armor Repair.
